clips.title: The story
paras: At Jordan Stilwell’s forge outside Ironforge, a paladin awaits the making of a mighty warhammer. You have gathered perilous components across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor for the smith. The hammer marks an apprentice’s passage into a recognized champion of the Light.

Outside Ironforge’s gates, master smith Jordan Stilwell works at his forge. He admits to envying paladins who wander the land, yet takes pride in serving their cause with hammer and anvil. You bring him rare materials gathered from shadowy crypts, sunken ruins, and dangerous mines. With them, Stilwell keeps his promise and forges a weapon worthy of a true defender.

Jordan Stilwell names the finished warhammer Verigan's Fist, honoring Bosch Verigan, an honored dwarven paladin and his dear friend. On behalf of himself and his wife, he places the sacred weapon in a young champion's hands. Through it, the memory and valor of his fallen friend endure against the darkness threatening Azeroth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.
When we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.
I'll be somewhat honest, friend, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here it is, friend. A weapon worthy of a champion of the Light such as yourself. I've named it after a great dwarven paladin who was a friend of mine. His name was Verigan... Bosch Verigan.
Please take it on behalf of myself and my wife. We owe you a great debt, and the world will be a safer place with one of your skill traveling the land.
